page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.large is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core and 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or a GPU, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The instance achieves average performance in single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU test, Geekbench single-core score, and single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core and memory-intensive benchmarks fall into the bottom 10% tier. This includes poor results in multi-core Geekbench, stress-ng multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks is also limited, placing in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested configurations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7ne.large offers dedicated Intel Xeon resources at a lower entry point, but the low multi-core resource density and constrained memory bandwidth limit its utility for heavy parallel processing. It is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded workloads, basic text processing, or low-traffic web serving where dedicated CPU allocation is required but massive multi-threaded throughput is not.
